queue_row_numbering: one-based data-row order, excluding the CSV header
viewing_method: seven generated contact sheets; 42 retained records traced to the preceding reviewed/adjudicated queue and eight newly sampled records inspected directly

classification_definitions.acceptable: visible fire is plausibly covered by the rendered box or the background image correctly contains no localized fire target
classification_definitions.questionable: a label may cover non-fire content or cannot be judged reliably at contact-sheet resolution
classification_definitions.incorrect: no visible fire is covered by the rendered box at contact-sheet resolution

interpretation: All 50 records in the final deterministic split- and box-size-stratified review queue were acceptable after record, box, and source-family adjudication.
The queue is enriched and deterministic rather than a simple random sample, so this result is not a whole-dataset error-rate estimate.
The review remains single-reviewer and cannot establish exhaustive annotation correctness.
